text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm… Maybe I should pay more attention to that stuff…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Well, Biko told me earlier that my skin looked so rough she mistook me for a kaiju…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I've never really thought much about my skin, but if Biko thinks it's that bad, maybe I should take better care of it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Self-conscious about the state of her rough skin, Hishi Akebono seems somewhat stressed…
